note: Deterministic staged scenes rendered from the live game via ?shot= URLs. Same seed => same frame.

shots.caption: Title screen: the neon skyline over a live city — traffic and pedestrians already moving behind the menu.
Mid-game: the Banshee GT rolling down Ocean Drive at 01:00 — headlights, wet asphalt sheen, traffic, and the story marker on the minimap.
Mission passed: the payout banner over live streets after the final story mission.
Four stars of trouble: cruisers closing in, a sedan cooking off, the searchlight, and the plaza lighting up.
